description: Requires signing in to GearHost. Traffic for the user's CloudSites: requests per day for the last 7 or 30 days (successful and not-found), bandwidth, and this billing cycle's requests against the plan's limit. Requests count every page and file served, not unique visitors; the numbers are refreshed about hourly. Use when the user asks how many visits or how much traffic a site gets. Omit domain for all sites. Read-only. Returns structuredContent { status, days, sites:[{domain, requests, ok, not_found, bandwidth_mb, cycle_requests, cycle_limit, daily:[{date, requests}]}] }.

domain.description: One CloudSite (its main address). Omit for all sites in the account.

name: get_site_stats
title: Get site traffic
